Ethan / team — quick technical inputs for the audit-log item and SOC 2 evidence: 

1) Audit logs — sample schema attached (audit_log_sample_schema.csv). Key fields we include: timestamp_utc, user_id, session_id, request_path, action_type, response_code, resource_id, kv_cache_hit, model_variant, token_count. Retention default is 90 days in hosted, with exports available for longer-term retention.

2) Sampling approach — for evaluation we can provide daily rolled samples (7 days) plus a 30-day aggregated summary. If you need full-stream for a particular window we can stage an export and share a secure GCS link; that will take ~48 hours to prepare.

3) SOC 2 evidence — I will populate the control matrix with links to the canonical artifacts (access-control screenshots, IAM role lists, change management tickets). Expect an initial pass by 2028-09-19.
